mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) compress equity discount rates and support positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days by reducing cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE has exceeded 5.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) create stagflation risk that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained housing market expansion (HOUST growth > 1.5% MoM for three consecutive months) boosts consumer confidence and disposable income, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: sustained housing market expansion (HOUST growth > 1.5% MoM for 3 months)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST growth has exceeded 1.5% MoM for three consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly job growth (PAYEMS increase > 100k) consistently signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings momentum, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS increases by more than 100k, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production growth below 0.5% MoM for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO MoM growth is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Prolonged manufacturing contraction (INDPRO growth < 0.0% MoM for three consecutive months) triggers risk-off sentiment that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: manufacturing contraction (INDPRO growth < 0.0% MoM for 3 months)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth has been below 0.0% MoM for three consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strong consumer spending (RSAFS growth > 1.0% MoM) and robust job growth (PAYEMS growth > 50k MoM) create a virtuous cycle of rising disposable income and consumption, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS MoM growth > 1.0% and PAYEMS MoM growth > 50k
regime_hint: consumer spending and labor market expansion
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS MoM growth > 1.0% and PAYEMS MoM growth > 50k, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.
